name: EXP-C1 · Day 0 · Dry run (no radio)
description: Rehearse the participant flow end to end with no radio dependency. Discovers a broken truth channel on Day 0 rather than with ten people standing in the hall.

config.description:
The whole participant flow with the radio left out, so the first time anyone reads these instructions is not the first time the hardware matters.

The phone does not illuminate — it marks block boundaries and carries the truth channel. Illumination is monad01 injecting on 2.4 GHz ch11.
The truth channel is a human act: it counts a person, not a phone.
One minute seated so the flow has a middle.
Scanning out is what makes the zone tally close.
If the tally moved in the admin panel, the people channel works.
